lesson.simple_car.title: Simple Car
lesson.simple_car.summary: Build a clear car from one long body, a smaller cabin and two wheels, then change the design to make it yours.
lesson.simple_car.step.body_base: Start with one long low body. Keep it wider than it is tall so the car has room for a cabin and wheels.
lesson.simple_car.help.body_base: Think of the body as the biggest shape in the drawing. Keep the top and bottom far enough apart to feel sturdy.
lesson.simple_car.complete.body_base: The long base gives the car its main proportion.
lesson.simple_car.step.cabin_wheels: Add the cabin above the body and place two wheels below. Compare their sizes instead of drawing each part alone.
lesson.simple_car.help.cabin_wheels: Keep the cabin smaller than the body. Put the wheels near opposite ends so the car feels balanced.
lesson.simple_car.complete.cabin_wheels: The cabin and wheel placement make the construction read as a car.
lesson.simple_car.step.details: Add two windows and simple front and rear lights. These details should support the big shapes, not take over the drawing.
lesson.simple_car.help.details: Keep the windows inside the cabin and the lights near the ends of the body. Exact shapes are not important.
lesson.simple_car.complete.details: The details now sit in clear places on the larger construction.
lesson.simple_car.step.design: Design your version. Try a stripe, roof detail, road, different body shape, number or any idea you like. These are suggestions, not requirements.
lesson.simple_car.help.design: Choose one change that gives the car personality. Stop when your design feels complete.
lesson.simple_car.complete.drawing: You built the car from proportion and placement, then changed the final design your way.
